green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
pink = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'P']

# Move all the way right

    green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']

    print(f"RIGHT: col={player_col}, Green={len(green)}, Pink={len(pink)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
